why_not_more: 1st/2nd Tank Divisions consume large re-equipment flows in Manchuria.
3rd Tank Division remains China-committed after Five-Go.
8th Regiment/Rabaul, 4th/NEI, 14th/Burma and New Caledonia are theater-fixed.
hundreds of physically surviving old vehicles are obsolete, training/static or in repair.
strategic_interpretation.why_more_than_historical_naive: Branch recovery and reliability preserve some hulls and crews; the effect appears primarily as better-filled formations and depot depth rather than a huge deployable surplus.
